scope: First one-generation flight-loop source/staging review; no actual game or Core flight test

findings.flight: All16 are airborne bodies, not standing idle renamed. Wings rise high, spread broad at power midpoint, beat below breast, then bend/recover; folded feet stay under belly.
findings.direction: Down/front, left, right, up/rear stay in their own rows. Beak/tail axes and dark small eyes retain the heading. Rear does not invent a side face.
findings.limbs: Two anatomical wings and two tucked feet; the far wing/feet are partly occluded by perspective and belly. No visible added limb, floating feather/body part or complete silhouette clipping.
findings.bodyAnchor: Each frame uses manual breast/body-core centre. Head-size approximate boxes show stable skull size within each row. Body and head reference projections are documented; rear head is partly hidden by the flight attitude, so its visible box is smaller.
findings.scale: One .055 scale for the whole source, no per-frame fit/shrink or direction mirroring. Existing idle/work comparison at .045. Full spread can reach20.955worldpx over a16px logical tile.
findings.native: 32x32 native world-pixel canvas and4x nearest enlargement contain entire wings. Four wing shapes and row headings remain distinguishable; fine eyes/toes/feather barbs do not all survive native scale.
findings.gutterLimitation: Requested wide gutters not achieved. Tightest source alpha>=16 silhouette gap2px; exact1px-margin rectangles can touch. Connected body pixels at alpha>=16 lost0, large neighbour0, alpha>=16 crop-border pixels0;26 border samples have alpha8..15. This low-alpha fringe is preserved from the source and is not an opaque halo.
findings.notIncluded: No takeoff, landing, glide/circling path, courier, icon, other species, fake floor/shadow/height/UI or new flight rules.

timingScope: 400ms is a recommendation in the standalone canvas; actual game cadence, distance and transitions not reviewed.
